items.comment: Accurate: unapply always returns Some(x), correctly described as an always-succeeding extractor. Two minor polish points, neither blocking: (1) the @return tag ('`x` wrapped in a [[scala.Some]]') is fully restated by the first sentence ('Returns the given product wrapped in a [[scala.Some]]...'), so per the house rule on redundant @return it could be dropped, though keeping it for symmetry with @param is a defensible stylistic choice; (2) the new @tparam docs say 'the type of the Nth component of the product' while the pre-existing trait's @tparam docs just below (lines 43-55, outside this diff) say 'the type of the Nth element' — a minor terminology inconsistency within the same file.
